borders.label: 边框 3 - Border 3
borders.description: Canva's iOS app is a friendly, confidence-building creation tool. Its whole personality says *you can design this* — to a non-designer, on a phone, in two minutes. The atmosphere is bright, rounded and gradient-forward. The default workspace is near-white (`#FFFFFF` / `#F7F8FA`), every container has a soft 12–16pt corner radius, and the unmistakable Canva signal is the cyan→purple brand gradient (`#00C4CC → #7D2AE8`). That gradient is the logo, the floating create button, the primary CTA, and the hero rails of the template galleries. Color is used generously but with discipline: the gradient for *brand and action*, full-color thumbnails for *content*, and a calm neutral grey for *chrome*.

panels.title: 以产品流程为中心
panels.body: 适合在 390×844 画布中预览的移动产品体验。

panels.title: 颜色与字体可复用
panels.body: 页面从本地 metadata 与 Design.md 提取 palette、typography 和标签，用于快速预览主题质感。

panels.title: 面向真实界面片段
panels.body: 按钮、输入、卡片和间距样例保持克制，便于比较不同主题的系统性差异。

do: 建议：Use a bright near-white workspace ({#FFFFFF} / {#F7F8FA}) light, warm-neutral ({#18191B}) dark — friendly, never harsh。
建议：Reserve the cyan→purple gradient ({#00C4CC → #7D2AE8}) for brand + primary action (logo, create FAB, primary CTA, hero rails)。
建议：Round everything generously — 12–16pt radii on cards/tiles/sheets, 999pt pills on buttons。
建议：Build home as greeting + big rounded search + horizontal design-type tile rail + stacked template galleries。
建议：Give each design-type tile its own gradient (Instagram, Presentation, Doc, Whiteboard, Video)。
dont: 避免：use pure black ({#000000}) for canvas or text — warm-neutral {#18191B} / near-black {#0D0E10}。
避免：overuse the gradient — secondary buttons are solid purple or neutral outline, not gradient。
避免：use sharp corners — Canva's softness (rounded, pill) is the entire brand feel。
避免：dim or desaturate content thumbnails in dark mode — only the chrome dims。
避免：put shadows on flat rows or chrome — shadows are for raised content cards and the FAB only。
